summary: Gasly's stunning Alpine upset pole position threatens Mercedes' straight-line dominance at Monza, setting up a three-way battle against Russell and Ferrari's resurgent pace. Hamilton's admission that Mercedes still trails on the straights despite Ferrari's engine upgrades opens the door for tactical pit-stop strategies and DRS train reshuffles throughout the race. A victory here would dramatically reshape the championship narrative, potentially handing Alpine momentum while either Mercedes or Ferrari seizes critical points in their ongoing power unit war.
